violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW SHELL EGGS STORED ABOVE SAUCES IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EMPLOYEE REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: PORK ROAST AT 54F UNDER HEAT LAMP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC RETURNED PORK CHOPS TO REFRIGERATOR UNTIL START OF LUNCH PREP PERIOD FOR REHEATING TO 165F OR ABOVE. MOVING FORWARD PIC WILL COOK ROAST ON MORNINGS FOR USE DURING LUNCH SERVICE. MEGABYTES EATERY (Inspection Date: 05/15/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: GRILLED ONIONS AT 54F NEAR GRILL.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control (TPHC) as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC WILL USE TPHC PROCEDURES AND DISCARD UNUSED OR UNSOLD ONIONS AT 11:30 AM. EHS WILL FORWARD TPHC DOCUMENTATION TO PIC.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED CFM CERTIFICATION EXPIRED 07/23/2025. PIC PROVIDED INVOICE FOR COMPLETED EXAMINATION AND INDICATED CERTIFICATE WOULD BE AVAILABLE ON 11//21/2025.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PLEASE EMAIL EHS CERTIFICATE ON RECEIPT OR BEFORE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW SHELLED EGGS OVER MILK IN RANDELL 2 DOOR PREP TOP; RAW SHELLED EGGS OVER PREPARED SAUCES AND RAW SHRIMP OVER PICKLED VEGETABLES IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.

PIC REORGANIZED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE..

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: WORKING SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF OILS, SAUCES AND WATER NEAR COOK LINE AND OVER PREP TOP WITHOUT LABELS.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC APPLIED LABELS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REHEAT ROASTED PORK TO 165F.
